source_pdf.source: User-supplied official ICCV 2023 PDF; not copied into Git

fields.Title: CRN: Camera Radar Net for Accurate, Robust, Efficient 3D Perception
fields.Task: 3D object detection; extensions to tracking and BEV semantic segmentation
fields.Radar_Type: Conventional automotive radar in nuScenes; not VoD 3+1D imaging radar
fields.Radar_Representation: Radar point clouds; pillar-style frustum encoding and radar BEV features
fields.Range: Main BEV range +/-51.2 m; long-range +/-102.4 m; Table 7 Car evaluation [0,100) m; not sensor maximum range
fields.Doppler: Yes; Doppler speed used as radar feature (Sec. 4.1)
fields.RCS: Yes; normalized RCS used as radar feature (Sec. 4.1)
fields.Elevation: No reliable radar elevation; height collapsed in RVT pillar-style representation (Secs. 3.1-3.2)
fields.Dataset: nuScenes; reported val/test protocols vary by table and model configuration
fields.Fusion_Level: Feature-level fusion: radar-assisted image view transformation (RVT), followed by multi-modal BEV feature aggregation (MFA)
fields.BEV: Yes; unified camera-radar BEV features for downstream tasks
fields.Temporal_Modeling: Current plus 3 previous BEV maps at 1-second intervals; six previous radar sweeps accumulated (Sec. 4.1)
fields.Cross_Attention: Yes; multi-modal deformable cross attention (MDCA) in MFA
fields.VLM: No VLM component in the published CRN method
fields.LLM: No LLM component in the published CRN method
fields.Radar_Token: No VLM-facing radar token interface; BEV attention queries are not language tokens
fields.Physical_Constraint: Calibration/projection geometry and radar spatial guidance in RVT; no separately claimed physics-consistency loss
fields.Uncertainty: Image depth distribution and radar occupancy response; not established as calibrated predictive uncertainty
fields.Adverse_Weather: Yes; sunny/rainy subset analysis in Table 9 and qualitative Fig. 5; not a guarantee for all adverse weather
fields.Night: Yes; day/night subset mAP in Table 9, under the reported configuration
fields.Occlusion: Qualitative occlusion examples in Figs. 4-5; view-drop Table 8 is not a controlled real-occlusion experiment
fields.Open_Source: Yes; official repository documentation inspected; code execution and full release coverage not verified
fields.Main_Contribution: RVT for radar-assisted image-to-BEV transformation; MFA with MDCA; optional top-K sparse aggregation
fields.Main_Limitation: Sparse/ambiguous radar inputs and imperfect spatial alignment remain design challenges; sparse aggregation has accuracy/speed tradeoffs; robustness conclusions are bounded by tested settings
fields.Potential_Gap: Candidate / Unverified: geometry reliability, modality conflict, sparse-region regression, alignment diagnostics and geometry-grounded VLM interfaces; novelty not established
fields.Reproduction_Value: Method-learning and reference value; not currently prioritized for engineering reproduction (maintainer decision)
fields.Reproduction_Difficulty: Not assessed by execution; legacy dependencies, GPU operators, data/license and checkpoint compatibility require audit
fields.Reading_Level: First-pass intensive reading completed; code-level second pass not started
fields.Reading_Status: Completed; teacher acceptance previously passed per user confirmation; original Q&A archive incomplete
fields.Relation_to_Our_Work: Camera-radar BEV fusion reference connecting P001 radar basics to later R4Det/MSSF reading; VLM extensions are project hypotheses
fields.Notes: paper_notes/P002_CRN.md; field evidence: papers/P002_CRN_RECORD.md; feasibility: reproductions/P002_CRN/README.md; no model execution, training or evaluation performed
